pages.title: A new school · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eight o’clock on a Monday in Boston. Noah walks into a big school with a new backpack. Students talk and laugh in the hall. He does not know any of them. A girl with a notebook smiles at him. Her name is Sara.
“Hi! Are you new here?” says Sara. “Yes. Today is my first day.” says Noah. “Welcome! I am Sara. What is your name?” says Sara.
